bootstrap_registries: bootstrap all d2go registries by scanning and lazily registering objects from all Python files in the package
break_bootstrap: break out of the bootstrap process mid-execution to skip remaining unexecutable code in a file
lazy_on_bootstrap: decorate a function to return a MagicMock during bootstrap instead of executing the real function body
BootstrapStatus: use the BootstrapStatus enum to check if a file was CACHED, FULLY_IMPORTED, PARTIALLY_IMPORTED, or FAILED during bootstrap
CachedResult: inspect a CachedResult dataclass to view the sha1 hash, registered names, and bootstrap status for a file
